title: IKEA PAX wardrobe with top cupboards

options.name: The design
options.text: Three IKEA PAX frames, 201 cm high, with mirror doors along the wall beside the door, built in with a scribed filler at the wall, a plinth panel and an end panel by the door. Above them a row of five made to measure MDF cupboards with push to open doors runs the whole width of the wall, over the door as well, with a plain panel above them up to the ceiling. Press Open the doors to see inside.

poster.alt: 3D model of three mirror door PAX wardrobes beside a panelled door, with a row of white top cupboards across the whole wall above them

sizes.label: PAX frames
sizes.value: 3 frames 50 cm wide, 201 cm high, 58 cm deep

sizes.label: Top cupboards
sizes.value: 5 cupboards about 504 mm wide and 650 mm high

sizes.label: Panel above
sizes.value: from the top cupboards to the ceiling

notes: The sizes are taken roughly from the drawing and have not been measured yet: the wall width, ceiling height, plinth and top cupboard heights will be checked on site.
The PAX frames are IKEA's standard sizes. The fittings inside are only an example of what can go in.
The top cupboards, the fillers and the panels are made to measure in MDF.
Colours on screen are a guide; the mirror doors are shown plain.
